role: Frame source adapters (live camera and video file) wrapping cv2.VideoCapture for Layer 2 perception pipeline
detail: Two context-manager classes implementing FrameSource protocol: CameraFrameSource opens physical camera by device index, applies capture settings (resolution, fps, buffer), and yields immutable Frame objects with JPEG-encoded data; VideoFileSource plays back video files frame-by-frame, returning None at EOF instead of raising. Both run blocking cv2 I/O in thread executors (asyncio.run_in_executor) to avoid blocking the event loop. cv2 imported lazily in __init__ so module is importable without [cv] extras; ImportError surfaces at construction time. Frame.observed_at captured immediately after cap.read() to reflect sensor time, not encoding time. Frame.frame_sequence monotonically incremented per instance to detect dropped frames via gaps. All reads wrapped in async with blocks for resource safety.
gotchas: cv2 module type-erased as object to avoid module-level cv2 import; type: ignore comments on union-attr reads due to lazy typing; dropped frames still increment sequence counter; JPEG encoding failure returns None without exception; VideoFileSource returns None on EOF (clean break, not error like CameraFrameSource might suggest)
